title: Version not found
message: The launcher could not find that Minecraft version.
fix: Reload the version list, then pick the version again.

title: Download failed
message: A file did not finish downloading.
fix: Check your connection and press Play again; finished files are kept.

title: Checksum mismatch
message: A downloaded file did not match its SHA-1.
fix: Delete the .part file and retry; if it repeats, change network.

title: Client jar missing
message: The version has no client jar on disk.
fix: Run the install again while online, or copy the jar in from another install.

title: Library download blocked
message: A library URL was refused.
fix: Try a different network; some school filters block Maven hosts.

title: Assets incomplete
message: The asset index finished but objects are missing.
fix: Run the install again; assets resume where they stopped.

title: Native extraction failed
message: A native library could not be unpacked.
fix: Close the game, delete versions/<id>/natives and relaunch.

title: Disk full
message: There is not enough free space.
fix: Free space on the drive holding the Minecraft folder.

title: Permission denied
message: The game folder is not writable.
fix: Move the game folder somewhere your user owns, or fix its permissions.

title: Unknown loader version
message: The loader has no build for that Minecraft version.
fix: Pick another loader or Minecraft version.

title: Game already running
message: A game session is already open in this window.
fix: Close the running game before starting another.

title: Version inherits too deeply
message: A profile points at itself through parents.
fix: Reinstall the loader profile.

title: Main class missing
message: The profile names a main class that is not on the classpath.
fix: Reinstall the loader; a library is missing.

title: Class not found
message: The game could not load a class.
fix: Check the mods folder for a jar built for another version.

title: Mixin apply failed
message: A mod mixin could not be applied.
fix: Remove the newest mod and try again.

title: Duplicate ASM
message: Two copies of ASM are on the classpath.
fix: Remove the duplicate library or the mod bundling it.

title: Window did not open
message: The process started but no window appeared.
fix: Check the session log; a graphics driver or LWJGL issue is common.

title: Game exited immediately
message: The game quit before reaching the menu.
fix: Read the log in the console card for the first error.

title: Session log missing
message: The launcher could not open a log file.
fix: Check free space and the logs folder.

title: Launch cancelled
message: The launch stopped before the game started.
fix: Try again; if it repeats, check the console output.

title: No Java found
message: No Java runtime was detected.
fix: Set a Java path in Settings or let Prime download one.

title: Java too old
message: The version needs a newer Java than the one found.
fix: Install the runtime the version asks for, or use auto.

title: Java path invalid
message: That path is not a Java executable.
fix: Pick java.exe from a runtime folder.

title: Runtime download failed
message: Mojang's runtime could not be downloaded.
fix: Retry on a network that can reach Mojang.

title: Runtime unpack failed
message: The downloaded runtime would not extract.
fix: Delete the runtimes folder entry and retry.

title: Java crashed
message: The JVM exited with an error.
fix: Lower memory or update Java; check the log.

title: Heap too large
message: The requested heap is larger than the system can give.
fix: Lower the memory in Settings.

title: 32-bit Java
message: A 32-bit runtime was picked.
fix: Use a 64-bit Java for modern versions.

title: Java check timed out
message: The runtime did not answer -version.
fix: Pick another runtime.

title: Unsupported Java
message: That Java version is not supported by this game version.
fix: Use the runtime the version requests.

title: Signed out
message: The Microsoft account has no stored token.
fix: Sign in again in Settings.

title: No Xbox profile
message: The account has never created an Xbox profile.
fix: Sign in at xbox.com once, then retry.

title: Family group
message: A family group must approve this account.
fix: Ask the family organiser to approve, then retry.

title: Does not own Minecraft
message: The account has no Java Edition profile.
fix: Use the account that bought Minecraft: Java Edition.

title: Consent blocked
message: Microsoft refused consent for the sign-in app.
fix: Use a personal Microsoft account, not a work or school one.

title: Code expired
message: The device code expired before it was approved.
fix: Start the sign-in again and approve promptly.

title: Sign-in declined
message: The approval was declined in the browser.
fix: Start again and approve the code.

title: Token refresh failed
message: The stored token could not be refreshed.
fix: Sign out and sign in again.

title: Sign-in window closed
message: The app closed before the code was exchanged.
fix: Keep Prime open until it says signed in.

title: Profile lookup failed
message: Minecraft services did not return a profile.
fix: Retry; if it repeats, check minecraft.net status.

title: Mojang unreachable
message: The launcher could not reach Mojang.
fix: Check the connection, VPN or proxy, then reload.

title: DNS failure
message: A host name did not resolve.
fix: Check DNS or try another network.

title: TLS failure
message: The secure connection failed.
fix: Check the system clock and any proxy.

title: Proxy refused
message: A proxy rejected the request.
fix: Fix the proxy settings in Windows.

title: Timeout
message: A request took too long.
fix: Retry; large downloads can time out on slow links.

title: Filtered network
message: The network blocks this host.
fix: Use a network without the filter.

title: Rate limited
message: The server asked the launcher to slow down.
fix: Wait a minute and retry.

title: Server error
message: The remote server returned an error.
fix: Retry later.

title: Offline mode
message: No network is available.
fix: Connect to use online features; offline play still works.

title: Manifest unavailable
message: The version manifest could not be loaded.
fix: Reload; a cached list is used when offline.

title: No compatible file
message: No mod file matches this version and loader.
fix: Pick another mod or version.

title: CurseForge key missing
message: CurseForge needs an API key.
fix: Add a key in Settings or use Modrinth.

title: Mod copy failed
message: A mod jar could not be copied.
fix: Check the file is not locked and the folder is writable.

title: Mods folder missing
message: The instance has no mods folder yet.
fix: Open the instance and add a mod once.

title: Wrong loader
message: The mod was built for another loader.
fix: Download the build for this loader.

title: Wrong game version
message: The mod targets a different Minecraft version.
fix: Pick the file for this version.

title: Duplicate mod
message: The same mod is installed twice.
fix: Remove one copy from the mods folder.

title: BTA mods elsewhere
message: BTA mods are not on Modrinth or CurseForge.
fix: Get them from betterthanadventure.net.

title: Search failed
message: The mod search request failed.
fix: Retry, or check the connection.

title: Download failed
message: A mod download did not finish.
fix: Retry the install.

title: Config unreadable
message: The config file could not be parsed.
fix: The last good backup is restored automatically.

title: Backup restored
message: Prime restored the previous config.
fix: Check your instances and settings.

title: Config write failed
message: The config could not be saved.
fix: Check free space and permissions.

title: Lock timeout
message: Another instance held the config lock.
fix: Close other Prime windows and retry.

title: Instance missing
message: That instance record no longer exists.
fix: Reload the instances page.

title: Instance folder missing
message: The instance folder was deleted outside Prime.
fix: Create a new instance or point the record at an existing folder.

title: Duplicate instance id
message: Two records share an id.
fix: Remove the duplicate from the list.

title: Invalid instance name
message: The name is empty or too long.
fix: Use 1-48 characters.

title: Accounts file unreadable
message: Stored accounts could not be read.
fix: Sign in again; tokens are re-created.

title: Unsupported config version
message: The config is newer than this build.
fix: Update Prime.

title: Update check failed
message: GitHub did not answer the release check.
fix: Retry later; the app works without it.

title: No releases
message: The repository has no published release.
fix: Publish a release or ignore this.

title: Asset missing
message: The latest release has no downloadable build.
fix: Open the release page instead.

title: Download failed
message: The update download did not finish.
fix: Retry from the release page.

title: Version compare failed
message: A release tag could not be read.
fix: Check the tag format (v1.2).

title: Update skipped
message: This release was skipped by choice.
fix: Clear the skip in Settings to be offered it again.

title: Release page blocked
message: The browser could not open the release page.
fix: Open github.com manually.

title: Checksum missing
message: The release has no checksum to verify.
fix: Verify the download by size.

title: Running from source
message: This build is not a packaged release.
fix: Updates apply to packaged builds.

title: Feed invalid
message: The custom update feed is not valid JSON.
fix: Fix or clear the feed URL.

title: Delete blocked
message: The instance is running.
fix: Stop the game first.

title: Folder delete failed
message: The instance folder could not be removed.
fix: Close anything using it and retry.

title: Instance dir create failed
message: The instance folder could not be created.
fix: Check permissions for the Minecraft folder.

title: Game dir not writable
message: The game folder is read-only.
fix: Pick another game folder in Settings.

title: Options copy failed
message: options.txt could not be copied.
fix: Copy it manually from the old folder.

title: Mods folder open failed
message: Explorer could not open the folder.
fix: Open it manually from the path shown.

title: Loader install failed
message: The loader installer returned an error.
fix: Check the console output for the installer message.

title: Loader profile unreadable
message: The loader wrote a profile Prime cannot read.
fix: Reinstall the loader.

title: Agent jar missing
message: The Java agent jar was not found.
fix: Pick the jar again.

title: Unsupported loader
message: That loader is not available yet.
fix: Pick a working loader.

title: Unexpected error
message: Something failed without a specific reason.
fix: Copy the console output when reporting it.

title: Cancelled
message: The action was cancelled.
fix: Start it again when ready.

title: Not implemented
message: That feature is planned, not built.
fix: Use the working path for now.

title: Invalid input
message: A field has a value the app cannot use.
fix: Fix the highlighted field.

title: File not found
message: A file the app expected is gone.
fix: Reinstall or re-add the file.

title: Access denied
message: Windows refused access to a path.
fix: Run from a folder your user owns.

title: Disk read error
message: A file could not be read.
fix: Check the drive health and retry.

title: Process start failed
message: The game process could not start.
fix: Check the Java path and antivirus.

title: Watcher task failed
message: The scheduled watcher could not run.
fix: Re-register it in Settings.

title: Unknown error
message: An error with no mapping occurred.
fix: Report it with the console output and this code.
